summary: The candidate fixes the default Transformers 5.12.1 generated-config crash and its regression suite passes, but it remains a partial fix: SGLang still forces deepseek_v4 through a V3-derived alias despite claiming native V4 parsing, and incomplete modern compression/RoPE mappings are silently converted to different runtime behavior rather than rejected.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction using a serialized Transformers DeepseekV4Config: indexer count was 0 and ModelConfig raised AttributeError for missing compress_ratios. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/j-cfe8cad72c79/base-repro.log

Passing candidate default generated-config path: one C4 indexer layer and per-layer ratios [128, 128, 128, 4]. The loaded class was still the SGLang V3-derived alias. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/j-cfe8cad72c79/candidate-repro.log
Candidate regression suite: 11 tests and 4 subtests passed. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/j-cfe8cad72c79/candidate-pytest.log

Independent adversarial inspection: partial modern rates silently normalized to [0, 4], a missing compress RoPE subsection silently normalized to {}, and get_config returned _DeepseekV4ConfigAlias instead of Transformers DeepseekV4Config. Raw log: /job/review-evidence/j-cfe8cad72c79/candidate-adversarial.log

gpu_execution.evidence: One ROCm GPU was visible, but no DeepSeek V4 weights were available; only deterministic CPU-side configuration and import-path behavior were tested.

remaining_counterexamples: deepseek_v4 remains registered to the V3-derived _DeepseekV4ConfigAlias, so the claimed native Transformers V4 parser path is not implemented.
A Transformers-created config with a partial compress_rates mapping silently maps an unmapped layer type to compression ratio 0 instead of rejecting the incomplete mapping.
Nested rope_parameters missing the active compress subsection silently becomes an empty/default scaling configuration instead of failing validation.
remaining_limitations: Transformers 5.12.1 was available rather than exactly 4.57.x; it emits the modern schema described by the issue.
No DeepSeek V4 weights were available, so weight loading, serving startup, GPU numerical parity, model accuracy, and distributed execution were not verified.
No native files changed in the candidate, so native rebuild was not applicable.
The tiny Llama serving fixture cannot validate DeepSeek V4 architecture or RoPE semantics and was not used as proof.
